# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is 98% of trials are not converted, because Trial users are not using/exploring the product as fully as they might.

_Working notes: Users enter the funnel but do not convert.  They also have high churn rate. Evidence: Only 2% of customers who begin a trial convert to paying customers,  One-year retention for paid customers is 40%, meaning 60% churn within a year Against the data: The data confirms my view that drop off is a major issue and a problem._

_____

## The bet

deliver content to users in the flow of their use to help them use the product and become more sticky

**Not doing:** not chasing referrals - we are ok at attracting customers but not converting them so this seems a more in product problem to solve form

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Content-Driven, The activation bottleneck isn't a traffic problem—it's a conversion problem. Trials are starting at a healthy 7.3% rate, but 98% never convert. This suggests users who start trials aren't realizing the product's value or don't understand how to get value from it. Content-driven loops (onboarding docs, in-trial guides, feature walkthroughs, success videos) could help trial users reach their aha moment faster and move toward activation.
